title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 6,301–6,350 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 現代國立大型海洋生物水族館；水族箱

examples.en: The national public aquarium houses tens of thousands of vibrant tropical fish in multi-million-liter tanks.
examples.zh: 國立大型「海洋生物水族館」（Aquarium），在數百萬公升的巨型水槽中悉心照料數萬條熱帶海洋生物。

examples.en: Setting up a small freshwater aquarium in the living room requires proper filtration and lighting.
examples.zh: 在客廳設置一個精緻的小型淡水水族箱，需要配置健全的過濾循環與專用水草照明設備。

examples.en: Families spent their Saturday afternoon marveling at playful otters inside the harbor aquarium.
examples.zh: 許多家庭利用週六午後造訪港灣水族館，興致盎然地觀賞水獺在水池中活潑嬉戲的可愛模樣。

words.definition: 巨型高強度無縫透明曲面壓克力板的

examples.en: High-tech transparent acrylic panels withstand immense water pressure without distorting the underwater view.
examples.zh: 高科技超厚透明「壓克力觀景窗」（Acrylic Panel），能承受龐大水壓且完全不扭曲水下觀看視野。

examples.en: The artist painted a colorful seascape on canvas using fast-drying acrylic pigments.
examples.zh: 青年畫家在粗麻畫布上運用快乾且色彩鮮豔的壓克力顏料，生動描繪壯麗的海岸風光。

examples.en: Sturdy acrylic sneeze guards were installed along cafeteria service counters to maintain hygiene.
examples.zh: 自助餐廳的供餐檯前全面加裝了堅固透明的壓克力防沫隔板，以維持食品衛生與健康安全。

words.definition: 厚達六十公分之超高抗壓透明大洋觀景窗；鑲板

examples.en: The monolithic viewing panel spans thirty meters wide, offering guests panoramic views of open ocean life.
examples.zh: 寬達三十公尺的一體成型「透明觀景大面板」（Panel），為遊客提供無死角的大洋生態全景視野。

examples.en: An expert panel of economists debated the monetary policy impacts on global trade.
examples.zh: 由資深經濟學家組成的專家論壇小組，深入辯論當前貨幣政策對跨國貿易帶來的深遠衝擊。

examples.en: Rooftop solar panels generate surplus green electricity that the homeowner sells back to the grid.
examples.zh: 屋頂上整齊鋪設的太陽能電池板產生充沛的綠色電力，讓屋主能將多餘電力回售給台電電網。

words.definition: 三百六十度全景沉浸式海底步道玻璃隧道；隧道

examples.en: Visitors strolling through the underwater walkthrough tunnel watch gigantic manta rays glide directly overhead.
examples.zh: 遊客漫步於三百六十度「海底玻璃隧道」（Tunnel），抬頭即可看見巨大的鬼蝠魟從頭頂優雅滑過。

examples.en: The engineering crew dug a five-kilometer railway tunnel straight through the granite mountain ridge.
examples.zh: 鐵路工程團隊歷經數年艱苦鑽探，成功貫通了一條穿透堅硬花崗岩山脈的五公里長鐵路隧道。

examples.en: Car headlights illuminated the curved concrete walls as the vehicle zipped through the expressway tunnel.
examples.zh: 車輛疾駛穿越快速道路隧道時，明亮的車頭大燈照亮了隧道內壁弧形的水泥反光牆面。

words.definition: 專業水族動物照護、餵養與飼育管理學

examples.en: Excellent aquatic animal husbandry requires deep knowledge of nutrition, water chemistry, and species behavior.
examples.zh: 卓越的「水族動物照護飼育管理」（Husbandry），需要融會貫通營養學、水質化學與動物行為學。

examples.en: Traditional animal husbandry in rural farming valleys focuses on ethical free-range poultry management.
examples.zh: 農村山谷裡的傳統畜牧飼育管理方式，著重於合乎動物倫理的放山人道禽畜飼養。

examples.en: Aquarium staff attend professional workshops on marine mammal husbandry and preventive healthcare.
examples.zh: 水族館專業照護專員定期參與海洋哺乳動物飼育照護與預防醫學研討會，精進專業技術。

words.definition: 水族館生命維持系統 (LSS 水質循環淨化)；支援

examples.en: Behind the exhibit walls, a sophisticated life support system operates twenty-four hours a day without pause.
examples.zh: 在展示牆背後，龐大複雜的「水族生命維持系統」（Life Support System LSS），二十四小時不間斷運轉淨化。

examples.en: Titanium rods and screws provide structural support to help the fractured bone heal correctly.
examples.zh: 外科醫師植入鈦合金骨板與骨釘提供堅固的結構支撐，協助粉碎性骨折骨骼精準對位癒合。

examples.en: Generous philanthropic donations provide vital financial support to local wildlife rescue shelters.
examples.zh: 社會各界善心人士的慷慨解囊捐款，為在地民間野生動物急難救傷庇護所提供了關鍵資金支援。

words.definition: 多段式大型石英砂與活性碳高壓過濾桶槽

examples.en: Continuous mechanical sand filtration removes suspended debris to maintain crystal-clear water clarity.
examples.zh: 二十四小時持續運轉的「石英砂機械過濾槽」（Filtration），濾除微小雜質以維持如水晶般清澈的水質。

examples.en: Upgrading municipal filtration plants ensures that suburban households receive clean drinking tap water.
examples.zh: 全面升級自來水廠的多段式濾砂過濾淨水設施，能確保廣大都會郊區家庭享有純淨的自來水。

examples.en: High-efficiency HEPA air filtration traps microscopic dust and pollen allergens inside hospital wards.
examples.zh: 醫療院所病房內部配置的高效能 HEPA 空氣過濾設備，能精準捕捉空氣中微米級粉塵與花粉過敏原。

words.definition: 蛋白質除沫器 (微氣泡泡沫分離器)

examples.en: Massive foam fractionator towers inject billions of micro-bubbles to strip dissolved organic waste from saltwater.
examples.zh: 巨型「蛋白質除沫分離器」（Fractionator），注入數十億顆微氣泡將水中有機廢物以泡沫形式刮除。

examples.en: Maintenance technicians clean the collection cup of the foam fractionator to remove thick brown residue.
examples.zh: 機電維修技師定時拆卸並清洗蛋白質除沫器的收集杯，徹底清除內部積聚的濃稠深褐色廢物。

examples.en: Installing an efficient fractionator significantly lowers the biological load on secondary filtration beds.
examples.zh: 在水族維生循環管線中加裝高效除沫器，能大幅減輕後續生物過濾床所承受的有機負荷。

words.definition: 臭氧強效消毒殺菌與微細懸浮有機物氧化

examples.en: Injecting controlled doses of ozone gas oxidizes yellow tints and sterilizes harmful waterborne pathogens.
examples.zh: 注入精準劑量的「臭氧氣體」（Ozone），能氧化分解水中黃褐色色素並瞬間消滅水中有害病原菌。

examples.en: The stratospheric ozone layer shields living organisms on Earth from dangerous solar ultraviolet radiation.
examples.zh: 高懸於平流層的臭氧層宛如一層天然保護傘，阻絕了來自太陽的有害紫外線輻射直接照射地表。

examples.en: Residual ozone is neutralized using carbon filters before treated water circulates back into animal exhibits.
examples.zh: 經臭氧消毒後的水體在回流至動物展缸前，必須先流經活性碳濾心以徹底中和殘留的臭氧分子。

words.definition: 流動床硝化細菌生物過濾槽 (分解氨氮)

examples.en: Millions of beneficial nitrifying bacteria colonize the plastic moving-bed biofilter media to detoxify water.
examples.zh: 數以億計的有益硝化細菌附著在「流動床生物過濾材」（Biofilter）上，默默分解水中劇毒排泄物。

examples.en: Establishing a mature biofilter requires cycling aquarium water for four weeks before introducing delicate fish.
examples.zh: 建立成熟健全的生物過濾系統，需要在正式引進嬌貴魚種前讓水體循環養水養菌長達四週。

examples.en: The municipal wastewater plant built a sprawling biofilter bed to decompose sulfur odors naturally.
examples.zh: 都市污水處理廠興建了大型生物濾床系統，利用特殊菌種自然分解消除污水散發的硫化氫惡臭。

words.definition: 魚類排泄之高毒性氨氮廢物 (轉化為亞硝酸鹽)

examples.en: High-affinity biological filters convert toxic ammonia secreted through fish gills into less dangerous compounds.
examples.zh: 頂級生物濾槽能迅速將魚鰓排泄出的「高毒性氨氮」（Ammonia），快速轉化為危害較低的化合物。

examples.en: Household cleaning supplies containing diluted ammonia must never be mixed with bleach products.
examples.zh: 家中存放含有稀釋氨水的清潔劑時必須格外小心，嚴禁與漂白水混用以避免產生劇毒氯氣。

examples.en: Even trace spikes in water ammonia levels can cause gill damage and respiratory distress in captive fish.
examples.zh: 水體中即使出現微量氨氮濃度的異常飆升，也會對水族缸內的魚類造成嚴重的鰓部損傷與呼吸困難。

words.definition: 亞硝酸鹽 (硝化細菌氧化分解轉化為硝酸鹽)

examples.en: Bacteria rapidly oxidize harmful nitrite into non-toxic nitrate, maintaining a safe aquatic habitat.
examples.zh: 硝化細菌迅速將有害的「亞硝酸鹽」（Nitrite）氧化為相對無毒的硝酸鹽，維繫水族生物安全。

examples.en: Aquarium test kits use colorimetric liquid reagents to detect minute concentrations of toxic nitrite.
examples.zh: 水族專用水質測試劑利用比色化學試劑，能精準檢測出水質中微量有害亞硝酸鹽的殘留濃度。

examples.en: During the initial tank cycling phase, nitrite spikes typically occur before beneficial bacteria reach equilibrium.
examples.zh: 在新缸養水循環初期，亞硝酸鹽濃度通常會先出現一段波峰，直到硝化系統完全建立平衡方才歸零。

words.definition: 硝酸鹽 (定期監控濃度並進行日常換水)

examples.en: Regular partial water changes keep accumulated nitrate concentrations well within healthy biological thresholds.
examples.zh: 定期進行部分海水換水，能將日積月累的「硝酸鹽濃度」（Nitrate）嚴格控制在健康安全標準之內。

examples.en: Excessive synthetic nitrate fertilizers washed into coastal bays trigger destructive red tide algal blooms.
examples.zh: 過量施用並隨雨水沖刷入海的化學硝酸鹽肥料，會在沿岸海灣引發破壞性的紅潮藻華氾濫。

examples.en: Hardy freshwater plants absorb inorganic nitrate as a nutrient, helping to maintain clean aquarium water.
examples.zh: 繁茂的水草水生植物會將水中的無機硝酸鹽作為生長養分吸收利用，自然協助淨化水族箱水質。

words.definition: 模擬大洋千分之三十五天然海水鹽度比重

examples.en: Digital optical refractometers measure aquarium water salinity to replicate open Pacific Ocean environments.
examples.zh: 數位光學折射儀隨時監測「海水鹽度」（Salinity），精準還原千分之三十五的太平洋天然海洋環境。

examples.en: Rising soil salinity caused by excessive irrigation makes coastal farmland unsuitable for conventional crops.
examples.zh: 不當過度灌溉導致土壤鹽鹼化鹽度攀升，使得沿海許多農耕良田不再適合種植一般傳統農作物。

examples.en: Mangrove trees developed specialized root mechanisms to tolerate high salinity and tidal inundation.
examples.zh: 紅樹林植物演化出獨特的根系排鹽與濾鹽生理機制，使其能在高鹽度潮間帶與潮水淹沒中蓬勃生長。

words.definition: 水質酸鹼度、水溫與溶氧量全天候監控參數

examples.en: Sensors transmit real-time water quality parameters including temperature, pH, and dissolved oxygen to tablets.
examples.zh: 智慧感測器將水溫、酸鹼值與溶氧量等各項「水質監控參數」（Parameters），即時傳送至飼育員平板上。

examples.en: Engineers defined strict safety parameters before launching the prototype electric vehicle into crash trials.
examples.zh: 車廠工程團隊在將電動車原型車推向撞擊測試場之前，預先界定了各項嚴格的安全性能評估參數。

examples.en: Setting the budget and timeline established clear parameters within which the construction team had to work.
examples.zh: 確立明確的工程預算上限與竣工時程，為營建施工團隊劃定了必須嚴格恪守的工作邊界與規範參數。

words.definition: 嬌貴造礁石珊瑚 (如鹿角珊瑚與腦紋珊瑚)

examples.en: Scleractinian stony corals construct massive calcium carbonate skeletons that form living underwater reefs.
examples.zh: 造礁「石珊瑚」（Stony Corals）分泌碳酸鈣骨骼，在漫長歲月中構築成萬千生物棲息的活體珊瑚礁。

examples.en: Snorkelers floated quietly above the shallow bay to admire vibrant colonies of staghorn coral.
examples.zh: 浮潛遊客靜靜漂浮在平靜的淺水灣水面上，由衷讚嘆水底生機勃勃、宛如鹿角般的繁茂珊瑚群。

examples.en: Ocean acidification threatens delicate coral polyps by dissolving their mineralized calcium protective homes.
examples.zh: 全球海洋酸化危機溶解了碳酸鈣礦物結構，正嚴重威脅著嬌弱珊瑚蟲用以遮風避雨的堅硬鈣質家園。

words.definition: 萬紫千紅色彩斑斕之熱帶活體珊瑚礁水族缸

examples.en: The vibrant living reef exhibit showcases symbiotic clownfish darting between swaying sea anemone tentacles.
examples.zh: 色彩斑斕的「活體珊瑚礁展示缸」（Living Reef），呈現小丑魚穿梭在海葵觸手間的生動共生畫面。

examples.en: The Great Barrier Reef is the largest living structure on Earth, visible from orbiting satellites.
examples.zh: 澳洲大堡礁是地球上規模最龐大的活體生命結構體，其宏偉輪廓甚至能從外太空衛星軌道上清晰看見。

examples.en: Local diving communities coordinate voluntary cleanup campaigns to remove ghost nets snagged on the reef.
examples.zh: 在地潛水愛好者社群自發組織淨海保育行動，合力拆除纏繞在天然礁岩上的廢棄幽靈沉船漁網。

words.definition: 珊瑚體內共生行光合作用微藻 (蟲黃藻)

examples.en: Microscopic photosynthetic zooxanthellae living inside coral tissues provide corals with ninety percent of energy.
examples.zh: 棲息於珊瑚細胞內部的「共生微藻蟲黃藻」（Zooxanthellae），透過光合作用供應珊瑚九成以上能量。

examples.en: When sea temperatures rise excessively, stressed corals expel their colorful zooxanthellae into the water column.
examples.zh: 當海水溫度異常飆升超過臨界值時，承受巨大熱壓力的珊瑚會被迫將體內的共生蟲黃藻排入海水中。

examples.en: Coral pigments act as natural sunscreens that protect their delicate zooxanthellae from ultraviolet damage.
examples.zh: 珊瑚體表所分泌的色彩斑斕螢光色素，如同天然防曬乳般保護著體內嬌弱的共生藻免受紫外線灼傷。

words.definition: 控溫攝氏二十五度嚴格防範高溫珊瑚白化；漂白

examples.en: Keeping chiller water temperatures below twenty-six degrees prevents thermal stress and deadly coral bleaching.
examples.zh: 將冷水機水溫嚴格維持在攝氏二十六度以下，能徹底防止熱壓力引發致命的「珊瑚白化現象」（Bleaching）。

examples.en: Widespread coral bleaching events during hot El Niño summers have decimated reefs across the tropics.
examples.zh: 在炎熱的聖嬰現象夏季所爆發的全球性大規模珊瑚白化事件，已重創了熱帶各大洋的大片珊瑚礁。

examples.en: If water temperatures cool quickly, bleached corals can reacquire algae and recover before starvation sets in.
examples.zh: 若海水溫度能在短時間內迅速回涼，白化的珊瑚有機會重新吸納微藻並在因饑餓死亡前奇蹟康復。

words.definition: 模擬熱帶陽光之全光譜高演色性水族燈具；光譜

examples.en: Advanced programmable LED fixtures emit a customized blue-rich light spectrum tailored for coral photosynthesis.
examples.zh: 先進可程式化 LED 燈具散發出專為珊瑚光合作用量身打造的高演色性「藍光光譜」（Light Spectrum）。

examples.en: Prisms refract white daylight into a magnificent visible color spectrum ranging from violet to deep red.
examples.zh: 光學三稜鏡能將白色的天然日光折射分解，呈現出從紫光到深紅光絢麗奪目的可見彩色光譜。

examples.en: The political candidates addressed a broad spectrum of civic issues ranging from healthcare to public transit.
examples.zh: 各候選人在電視政見發表會上，針對從全民健保到大眾公共運輸等廣泛多元的公共議題深入交鋒。

words.definition: 光合有效輻射量 (PAR 照度計精準測量)；輻射

examples.en: Aquarists use PAR meters to verify that photosynthetically active radiation reaches light-hungry coral frags.
examples.zh: 飼育員手持儀器精準測量「光合有效輻射量」（Active Radiation PAR），確保每一株喜光珊瑚皆沐浴在充足光照下。

examples.en: Protective lead aprons shield patients from stray scattered radiation during dental X-ray procedures.
examples.zh: 牙醫診所醫護在為病患進行牙科 X 光拍攝時，會貼心為病患穿戴鉛衣以阻隔多餘散射輻射。

examples.en: The warm infrared radiation emitted by the crackling fireplace kept the rustic mountain cabin cozy.
examples.zh: 壁爐中劈啪作響的柴火散發出溫暖柔和的紅外熱輻射，讓這座質樸的高山木屋充滿了溫馨與暖意。

words.definition: 微珊瑚斷片快速切割無性人工繁育技術

examples.en: Micro-fragmentation techniques cut mother colonies into tiny pieces, accelerating coral regrowth twenty-fold.
examples.zh: 採用「微珊瑚斷片切割技術」（Micro-Fragmentation），能將珊瑚母株切成微小組織，加速生長達二十倍。

examples.en: Severe habitat fragmentation isolates wildlife populations and impairs their long-term genetic viability.
examples.zh: 嚴重的棲地破碎化將原本連續的野生動物族群孤立切割，嚴重危害了物種長期的基因多樣性與存續。

examples.en: Digital disk defragmentation reorders scattered file sectors to speed up vintage desktop computer performance.
examples.zh: 傳統電腦磁碟重組工具能將散落在硬碟各處的檔案碎片重新整理排序，有效提升老舊電腦運行效能。

words.definition: 滿月之夜人工環境模擬誘導珊瑚集體產卵

examples.en: Scientists simulated lunar cycles in indoor labs to trigger synchronous evening coral spawning events.
examples.zh: 科學家在室內精準模擬月相週期與潮汐變化，成功誘導各品種珊瑚在夜間進行震撼的「集體同步產卵」（Spawning）。

examples.en: Millions of wild salmon swim thousands of miles upstream against rushing currents for seasonal river spawning.
examples.zh: 數以百萬計的野生鮭魚在繁殖季節逆流而上數千里，奮力穿越湍急瀑布返回誕生河流進行產卵繁衍。

examples.en: During nocturnal mass spawning, trillions of pink gamete bundles float like an upside-down snowstorm.
examples.zh: 在夜間大集體產卵時，數以兆計的粉紅色卵子與精子束在海水中冉冉升起，宛如一場倒著下的絢爛暴風雪。

words.definition: 浮游狀珊瑚實囊幼蟲著床附著陶片；幼蟲

examples.en: Swimming planula coral larvae settle onto specialized textured ceramic plugs to begin forming new colonies.
examples.zh: 具有游動能力的「珊瑚幼蟲」（Larvae），紛紛降落並牢牢附著在特製陶質底座上，展開全新生命循環。

examples.en: The caterpillar feeds voraciously on fresh mulberry leaves during its developmental larva stage.
examples.zh: 毛毛蟲在脆弱的幼蟲發育階段貪婪啃食新鮮桑葉，積聚大量能量以準備迎接收繭羽化的蛻變時刻。

examples.en: Biologists examined the microscopic mosquito larva swimming in stagnant water buckets.
examples.zh: 登革熱防治防疫人員手持放大鏡，仔細檢查廢棄積水塑膠水桶中孳生游動的微小孑孓幼蟲。

words.definition: 海底人工珊瑚育苗架與野外復育苗圃；苗圃

examples.en: Healthy micro-colonies grown in the aquarium nursery are transplanted back onto degraded wild reefs.
examples.zh: 在水族館「珊瑚復育苗圃」（Coral Nursery）培育茁壯的健康幼株，被潛水員親手移植回退化的野外礁岩。

examples.en: The community plant nursery sells native flowering shrubs to attract pollinators to urban home gardens.
examples.zh: 社區綠化苗圃對外展售原生開花灌木與蜜源植物，鼓勵市民在都市陽台營造友善蝴蝶的綠色花園。

examples.en: Expectant parents painted the cozy nursery room in pastel colors and assembled the wooden crib.
examples.zh: 滿懷期待的準爸媽將溫馨舒適的嬰兒房粉刷上柔和的粉彩色系，並齊心協力組裝好精緻的木製嬰兒床。

words.definition: 威風凜凜的大洋巨獸沙虎鯊與鯨鯊；鯊魚

examples.en: Sand tiger sharks patrol the open ocean exhibit gracefully with rows of sharp, backward-pointing teeth.
examples.zh: 體型雄偉的沙虎「鯊魚」（Shark），露出一排排鋒利交錯的牙齒，威嚴且優雅地在大洋水槽中巡弋。

examples.en: Whale sharks feed harmlessly on plankton and tiny fish by filtering vast volumes of surface seawater.
examples.zh: 體型巨大的鯨鯊個性溫馴無害，僅靠著在表層大口濾食大量海水中的微小浮游生物與小魚蝦為生。

examples.en: Banning shark fin trading in international markets is crucial for ending destructive high-seas finning.
examples.zh: 在國際公約全面禁止魚翅貿易與非法捕撈，是終結公海上殘忍割鰭棄鯊惡劣行徑的關鍵一步。

words.definition: 水中如鳥類般振翅優雅滑翔之雪花鴨嘴燕魟；光線

examples.en: Spotted eagle rays flap wide pectoral fins gracefully, seeming to fly weightlessly through blue water.
examples.zh: 滿身雪花斑點的「燕魟」（Rays），拍動著如鳥翼般寬闊的胸鰭，彷彿在深藍大海中無重力翺翔。

examples.en: Morning sun rays filtered through thick forest mist, illuminating golden ferns along the mountain path.
examples.zh: 清晨的第一道明媚晨光穿透高山濃霧，在蜿蜒的森林步道兩旁照亮了閃耀金色光芒的翠綠蕨類。

examples.en: Divers gently hovered alongside the harmless manta ray as it performed somersaults over cleaning stations.
examples.zh: 潛水員在海底清潔站旁屏息靜靜漂浮，近距離欣賞巨大溫馴的鬼蝠魟在水下優雅連續翻筋斗的英姿。

words.definition: 職業水肺潛水水槽清潔維護與餵食員；潛水員

examples.en: Certified commercial maintenance divers enter the deep tank twice a week to clean acrylic glass and feed sharks.
examples.zh: 領有國際執照的專業「水槽維護潛水員」（Diver），每週潛入深水槽擦拭壓克力玻璃並進行定點餵食。

examples.en: The search and rescue diver plunged into freezing river waters to search for the missing kayak.
examples.zh: 搜救特警隊專業潛水員毫不猶豫躍入冰冷刺骨的湍急溪水中，全力搜尋失聯的泛舟獨木舟。

examples.en: Underwater camera divers documented the annual whale shark migration off the tropical archipelago.
examples.zh: 水下專業攝影潛水團隊攜帶頂級防水相機，完整記錄了熱帶群島外海一年一度壯觀的鯨鯊遷徙盛況。

words.definition: 搭載全罩式面罩水下無線通話水肺裝備

examples.en: Equipped with full-face communication scuba gear, divers speak live to excited audiences during feeding shows.
examples.zh: 配備全罩式水下無線通話「水肺裝備」（Scuba Gear），潛水員在餵食秀現場能即時與玻璃窗外的觀眾生動對話。

examples.en: Earning her international open-water scuba certification opened up a vibrant underwater world of discovery.
examples.zh: 順利考取國際開放水域水肺潛水證照，為喜愛海洋的女孩打開了一扇探索繽紛水下世界的夢想大門。

examples.en: Pre-dive checks verify that scuba regulator hoses and air pressure gauges are functioning safely.
examples.zh: 每次潛水前嚴格的裝備雙重檢查，確保水肺調節器呼吸管線與殘壓表皆處於百分之百正常運作狀態。

words.definition: 針對大型掠食性鯊魚之長竿精準定點餵食

examples.en: Target feeding with specialized tongs ensures every individual shark receives its prescribed vitamin-rich fish meal.
examples.zh: 透過長夾進行「精準定點餵食」（Target Feeding），確保每隻鯊魚都能吃到塞入專屬綜合維生素的新鮮魚餌。

examples.en: Public feeding demonstrations teach audiences about the unique hunting adaptations of predatory animals.
examples.zh: 公開的水族餵食解說展演，深入向參觀民眾介紹肉食掠食性動物令人驚嘆的獨特捕食生理適應。

examples.en: The mother bird flew back and forth from dawn till dusk, feeding her chirping chicks in the nest.
examples.zh: 鳥媽媽從清晨到黃昏不知疲倦地在林間往返穿梭，為鳥巢中嗷嗷待哺、嘰嘰喳喳的小雛鳥銜來肥美小蟲。

words.definition: 伸縮式不銹鋼水下專用餵食長竿；竿子

examples.en: Aquarists extend a long fiberglass pole tipped with mackerel to deliver food directly to the bottom-dwelling nurse shark.
examples.zh: 飼育員伸出長長的「玻璃纖維餵食竿」（Feeding Pole），將新鮮鯖魚準確送至趴在水底的鉸口鯊嘴邊。

examples.en: Explorers pitched their waterproof tent using durable aluminum poles anchored securely against the wind.
examples.zh: 極限探險隊員在強風呼嘯的山脊上，利用堅固的航太鋁合金營柱迅速搭建起防風防雨的專業帳篷。

examples.en: Navigators looked toward the North Pole star to steer their wooden sailing vessel through open waters.
examples.zh: 古代航海先驅在茫茫黑夜的大海中仰望北極星定位，指引木造帆船在狂風巨浪中破浪前行。

words.definition: 幾何圖形標靶水下動物制約行為訓練；目標

examples.en: When presented with a yellow plastic target board, the trained stingray swims up calmly to receive its treat.
examples.zh: 當潛水員出示專屬的黃色圓形「塑膠標靶」（Target），受過訓練的魟魚會溫馴靠攏等待獎勵美食。

examples.en: The retail company achieved its quarterly sales target two weeks ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 該大型跨國零售企業憑藉靈活的行銷策略，提早整整兩週順利達成了本季度的業績營收目標。

examples.en: Precision medicine aims to target cancer cells selectively without damaging normal healthy tissues.
examples.zh: 當代精準標靶醫療的核心目標，在於具備選擇性鎖定消滅癌細胞的同時，完全不傷及健康人體組織。

words.definition: 正向增強獎勵制約行為訓練 (利於例行健檢)

examples.en: Positive reinforcement behavioral conditioning allows veterinarians to perform routine blood tests without stress.
examples.zh: 透過「正向增強行為制約訓練」（Conditioning），獸醫師無需麻醉即可在零壓力下為巨型海洋生物抽血健檢。

examples.en: Elite marathon runners undergo rigorous cardiovascular conditioning to boost their endurance.
examples.zh: 頂尖職業馬拉松長跑選手必須接受嚴苛的心肺功能強化體能訓練，以大幅提升長途奔馳耐力。

examples.en: Pavlov’s famous behavioral conditioning experiments proved that dogs could associate ringing bells with food.
examples.zh: 生理學家巴夫洛夫著名的行為制約反射實驗證實，動物大腦能將搖晃的鈴聲與美味食物建立神經聯想。

words.definition: 專業大型海洋與水族動物臨床獸醫醫療的

examples.en: Specialized veterinary teams perform regular underwater ultrasounds to monitor pregnant sea turtles.
examples.zh: 專業「水族獸醫團隊」（Veterinary Team），定期攜帶防水水下超音波為即將臨盆的綠蠵龜進行產檢。

examples.en: She enrolled in veterinary medicine to fulfill her childhood ambition of caring for injured wildlife.
examples.zh: 她毅然報考獸醫學系，只為實踐從小立志拯救並悉心醫治受傷流浪動物與野生生靈的童年夢想。

examples.en: The mobile veterinary clinic provides free vaccinations and health checks to pets in remote rural villages.
examples.zh: 巡迴流動獸醫診療車每週開進偏遠偏鄉部落，為山區弱勢家庭的貓狗寵物提供免費狂犬病疫苗注射與健檢。

words.definition: 新進魚類三十天強制檢疫隔離觀察缸；檢疫

examples.en: All newly arrived fishes spend thirty days in the strict bio-secure quarantine facility before joining main tanks.
examples.zh: 所有新引進的水族生物，在入主展缸前必須在「嚴格檢疫隔離中心」（Quarantine）觀察三十天。

examples.en: Public health officials imposed mandatory hotel quarantine on international arrivals during the epidemic.
examples.zh: 衛生防疫主管機關在重大傳染病流行期間，要求所有境外入境旅客必須在合格防疫旅館落實隔離檢疫。

examples.en: Plants intercepted at border customs underwent strict phytosanitary quarantine to stop invasive insect pests.
examples.zh: 在海關機場邊境查獲的未申報活體植株，必須依法接受嚴格動植物防檢疫處理以全面阻絕外來害蟲入侵。

words.definition: 顯微鏡鰓部與皮膚微小體外寄生蟲精密篩檢；寄生蟲

examples.en: Freshwater dips and microscopic smear checks eliminate external skin parasites from wild-collected specimens.
examples.zh: 進行短暫淡水浴與顯微抹片檢查，能徹底清除野生引進個體體表與鰓部潛在的「微小寄生蟲」（Parasites）。

examples.en: Ticks and fleas are common external parasites that irritate household dogs and transmit blood infections.
examples.zh: 壁蝨與跳蚤是常見的體表外寄生蟲，不僅會引發家犬皮膚搔癢紅腫，更容易傳播萊姆病等血液傳染病。

examples.en: The selfish relative acted like a social parasite, refusing to work while living off his family’s savings.
examples.zh: 這名遊手好閒的親戚宛如社會寄生蟲般，長年不願踏實工作，只會一味榨取揮霍長輩辛苦積攢的養老金。

words.definition: 全方位海洋動物身心健康福祉指標

examples.en: Enrichment toys and varied sensory stimuli support the holistic psychological wellness of captive dolphins.
examples.zh: 提供豐富化益智玩具與多元感官刺激，全面保障水族館海豚與海獅的心理「健康與生活福祉」（Wellness）。

examples.en: The corporate retreat included morning yoga and mindfulness seminars focused on employee wellness.
examples.zh: 該企業年度員工共識營貼心安排了清晨晨曦瑜伽與正念靜心講座，全力守護同仁的身心靈全人健康。

examples.en: Proper sleep, balanced nutrition, and regular exercise are cornerstones of lifelong personal wellness.
examples.zh: 充足高質量的睡眠、均衡營養的飲食與規律運動習慣，是打造終身長效健康與美好生活的黃金基石。

words.definition: 圓形環流水母缸中優雅漂浮之海月水母；水母

examples.en: Delicate moon jellyfish drift like floating ghosts under rotating multicolor LED lights in the dark gallery.
examples.zh: 嬌柔透明的海月「水母」（Jellyfish），在幽暗展廳繽紛變幻的 LED 燈光下如夢似幻地悠游漂浮。

examples.en: Bathers along the coast were warned to avoid swimming near swarms of stinging box jellyfish.
examples.zh: 海灘救生員透過廣播鄭重提醒在海邊戲水的泳客，切勿靠近可能出沒著劇毒箱形水母的淺水礁石區。

examples.en: Despite having no brain or heart, jellyfish have thrived successfully across world oceans for millions of years.
examples.zh: 儘管身體內部完全沒有大腦、心臟與骨骼構造，水母卻已在浩瀚各大洋中繁衍生息了數億年之久。

words.definition: 專利無死角環形層流水母展示缸 (Kreisel) 的

examples.en: Specialized circular kreisel tanks maintain a gentle, continuous water current that keeps jellyfish from sinking.
examples.zh: 專利「環形水流無死角水母缸」（Circular Kreisel Tank），以溫柔循環水流托住水母脆弱柔軟的軀體。

examples.en: Guests gathered around the circular oak dining table for a festive Thanksgiving dinner.
examples.zh: 遠道而來的親朋好友圍坐在客廳溫馨的大圓形橡木餐桌旁，一同享用熱騰騰的感恩節團聚大餐。

examples.en: The flight pattern placed the inbound aircraft into a circular holding stack until a landing runway cleared.
examples.zh: 由於降落跑道暫時繁忙，航管中心指示即將進場的客機在機場上空依序進行圓形環狀盤旋等待。

words.definition: 如催眠般規律收縮跳動之透明傘狀體的

examples.en: Guests watch the mesmerizing, pulsating motions of translucent medusa bells expanding and contracting peacefully.
examples.zh: 觀眾屏息凝視著透明水母傘狀體如催眠般「規律收縮跳動」（Pulsating），心靈瞬間獲得極致平靜。

examples.en: The city center was electrified by pulsating bass rhythms booming from the open-air techno concert.
examples.zh: 露天電子音樂祭現場舞台巨型音響重低音節奏狂暴震撼脈動，讓整個市中心廣場瞬間沸騰瘋狂。

examples.en: The emergency beacon flashed a pulsating amber strobe to warn motorists of the road hazard ahead.
examples.zh: 國道工務巡邏車在故障拋錨車輛後方開啟規律閃爍跳動的琥珀色警示燈，提醒後方駕駛人及早變換車道。

words.definition: 零下低溫極地館中成群搖擺之巴布亞企鵝

examples.en: Chilly sub-zero enclosures feature refrigerated snowbanks where gentoo penguins dive and waddle playfully.
examples.zh: 終年維持零下的極地展館中設有冷凝造雪機，一群活潑可愛的紳士「企鵝」（Penguin）在雪地上搖擺跳水。

examples.en: Emperor penguin fathers huddle together against Antarctic blizzards to incubate eggs on their feet.
examples.zh: 勇敢無畏的帝王企鵝爸爸們在零下數十度的南極狂暴風雪中緊緊依偎取暖，將企鵝蛋放在腳掌上悉心孵化。

examples.en: Children cheered with joy as the clumsy penguin stumbled on the ice before sliding effortlessly into the pool.
examples.zh: 當看似笨拙的企鵝在冰面上滑了一跤隨後順勢滑入水中優雅暢游時，岸邊的小朋友發出歡樂的尖叫與歡呼。

words.definition: 陽光穿透三層樓高之巨型加州巨藻林展示槽

examples.en: Golden sunlight filters through towering giant kelp stalks reaching three stories high in the cold-water tank.
examples.zh: 金色陽光穿透高達三層樓的「加州巨藻林水槽」（Giant Kelp Forest），在冷水波光間搖曳生姿。

examples.en: Coastal kelp forests provide critical nursery habitats and protection for juvenile sea otters and rockfish.
examples.zh: 沿岸海域茂密的天然海藻森林，為初生的野生小海獺與各種岩礁幼魚提供了遮蔽庇護與安全育苗溫床。

examples.en: Japanese culinary broths utilize sun-dried kombu kelp to extract deep, naturally savory umami notes.
examples.zh: 日式精緻高湯料理精選天然日曬的厚實昆布海帶（Kelp），慢火細熬萃取出甘醇濃郁的極致鮮味精華。

words.definition: 模擬大自然潮間帶真實海浪湧動之造浪系統；湧現

examples.en: Pneumatic surge generators periodically dump gentle waves across the rocky shoreline exhibit.
examples.zh: 氣壓式「波浪湧動造浪機」（Surge Generator），定時向岩石礁岸展區傾瀉出一波波逼真的天然潮湧。

examples.en: A sudden surge in global semiconductor orders encouraged local factories to expand manufacturing shifts.
examples.zh: 全球半導體先進製程晶片訂單迎來一波爆發性急遽湧現增長，促使晶圓代工大廠迅速啟動擴產輪班。

examples.en: Coastal seawalls were reinforced to withstand destructive storm surges generated by approaching typhoons.
examples.zh: 沿海防波堤與海堤全面進行防護拋石加固，以有效抵禦強烈颱風直撲時所掀起毀滅性暴潮的狂暴衝擊。

words.definition: 世界級寓教於樂沉浸式海洋科普常設展覽

examples.en: The world-class deep-sea exhibition combines tactile models with interactive touchscreen learning kiosks.
examples.zh: 這場世界級的深海「科普常設展覽」（Exhibition），將實體觸摸模型與互動觸控多媒體完美結合。

examples.en: Thousands of visitors queued outside the fine arts museum to tour the visiting impressionist exhibition.
examples.zh: 數以萬計熱愛藝術的參觀民眾在國立美術館門外大排長龍，爭睹難得一見的法國印象派大師巡迴真跡特展。

examples.en: The industrial trade exhibition showcased cutting-edge automation robots and smart warehouse logistics.
examples.zh: 台北國際自動化工業大展在南港展覽館隆重揭幕，匯聚展示了當代最頂尖的機器人手臂與智慧倉儲物流。

words.definition: 親身觀察活體生物之第一線海洋保育教育

examples.en: Hands-on marine education inspires thousands of visiting schoolchildren to stop using single-use plastic straws.
examples.zh: 寓教於樂的生動「海洋環境教育」（Education），啟發了無數來訪學童自發性在生活中拒用一次性塑膠吸管。

examples.en: Investing in accessible public education provides underprivileged children with ladders of social mobility.
examples.zh: 持續擴大投資普及且優質的公共國民教育資源，能為偏鄉與弱勢家庭學童鋪就翻轉階級的堅實階梯。

examples.en: The foundation conducts financial literacy education workshops for young adults entering the workforce.
examples.zh: 該公益基金會每季定期為即將步入職場的社會新鮮人開辦實用的個人理財與防詐騙教育生活工作坊。

words.definition: 志工專業引導下觸摸池海星溫柔互動

examples.en: Guided touch-pool interaction allows children to feel the spiny skin of sea stars and the hard shell of crabs.
examples.zh: 在導覽志工的引導下進行「觸摸池親身互動」（Interaction），讓孩子親手感受海星的粗糙骨針與海膽硬殼。

examples.en: Genuine social interaction with diverse friends enriches empathy and reduces cultural prejudices.
examples.zh: 在日常生活中與不同文化背景的朋友進行真誠深入的交流互動，能豐富同理心並消除偏見隔閡。

examples.en: The user interface designer improved screen touch interaction to make the smartphone app more responsive.
examples.zh: 使用者介面（UI）設計師大幅優化了螢幕觸控互動反饋流暢度，讓手機應用程式操作體驗更為靈敏順手。

words.definition: 點燃下一代立志守護蔚藍大海之無限靈感

examples.en: Standing before the massive blue tank sparks lifelong scientific inspiration in future marine biologists.
examples.zh: 佇立在浩瀚湛藍的巨型大洋展示窗前，在未來海洋生物學家的幼小心靈中點燃了「守護海洋的無窮靈感」（Inspiration）。

examples.en: The poet drew artistic inspiration from misty dawn walks through ancient cypress mountain trails.
examples.zh: 這位才華洋溢的桂冠詩人經常漫步於清晨薄霧籠罩的古老紅檜巨木步道，從大自然神韻中汲取豐沛創作靈感。

examples.en: Her remarkable courage in triumphing over physical paralysis served as a source of inspiration to thousands.
examples.zh: 她以無比堅韌的毅力戰勝全身癱瘓重新站起來的非凡故事，成為鼓舞千千萬萬遭遇挫折者的強大心靈靈感。

words.definition: 培養珍惜海洋資源愛護地球之公民守護職責

examples.en: Public aquariums nurture a collective sense of environmental stewardship toward vulnerable marine habitats.
examples.zh: 現代公立水族館深耕社會責任，全力培養全體公民珍惜脆弱海洋生態的「地球守護者責任」（Stewardship）。

examples.en: Indigenous tribes have practiced sacred land stewardship for millennia without exhausting natural resources.
examples.zh: 台灣原住民族部落數千年來身體力行敬畏大地的土地管理與守護智慧，取之有度且絕不過度榨取大自然。

examples.en: Corporate leaders must embrace ethical stewardship that prioritizes planetary sustainability alongside profits.
examples.zh: 現代跨國企業領袖在追求財務獲利的同時，必須自覺承擔起守護地球環境永續發展的崇高社會受託責任。

words.definition: 仰望漫天游魚由衷生起之純真驚嘆與震撼

examples.en: Gazing upward at schools of shimmering silver sardines fills every visitor's heart with childlike wonder.
examples.zh: 仰望漫天盤旋、閃爍銀色粼粼波光的沙丁魚風暴，每個人的心中都充滿了最純真的「驚嘆與敬畏」（Wonder）。

examples.en: We can only wonder what deep space secrets the next generation of space observatories will uncover.
examples.zh: 我們由衷好奇與遐想，人類下一代更為先進的深空天文望遠鏡將會揭開哪些深藏宇宙的終極奧秘。

examples.en: Traveling through remote snow-covered peaks revived his dormant sense of poetic wonder.
examples.zh: 隻身徒步穿越白雪皚皚的偏遠高山峻嶺，重新喚醒了他內心深處長年被塵封的詩意驚嘆與感動。

words.definition: 守護瀕危海洋物種之現代蔚藍方舟與避難所

examples.en: Modern aquariums serve as an educational sanctuary and conservation ark for disappearing coral reef species.
examples.zh: 現代水族館肩負重任，已成為瀕危海洋物種繁衍生息、對抗滅絕的「蔚藍方舟與安全庇護所」（Sanctuary）。

examples.en: The peaceful temple grounds provide a quiet spiritual sanctuary away from the deafening city traffic.
examples.zh: 古剎廟宇寧靜清幽的庭院禪房，為奔波勞碌的都會人提供了一處遠離滾滾紅塵與車馬喧囂的心靈避風港庇護所。

examples.en: The coastal wetlands were declared a national wildlife sanctuary to protect endangered migratory spoonbills.
examples.zh: 該片沿海濕地正式被依法劃設為國家級野生動物保護區，全力守護全球瀕危的珍稀過境黑面琵鷺。
